managed_device.title: Managed device - dry-run simulation
managed_device.description: Enter the load data. Casa ES only simulates whether it could start; this version does not send real commands. Numeric priority: 1 = highest, 10 = lowest.

data.name: Device name
data.min_battery_soc: Minimum battery SOC to allow the device (%)
data.allow_grid: Allow grid energy for this device
data.enabled: Enable this device in Casa ES management

data_description.name: Use a recognizable name, for example Boiler, Dehumidifier, Living room AC or Dishwasher.
data_description.entity_id: Select the entity Casa ES may control in the future, such as switch.boiler or climate.living_room. In dry-run it is only read and simulated.
data_description.power_sensor: Optional but recommended. Select a sensor measuring only this appliance in W, kW or MW. It helps determine whether the appliance is actually consuming. Leave empty if unavailable.
data_description.nominal_power_w: Enter the typical electrical draw while active. Casa ES uses it to test instantaneous start headroom and estimate cycle energy.
data_description.priority: Number from 1 to 10. Lower numbers run first: 1 before 2, 2 before 3, through 10. Multiple devices may share the same number.
data_description.phase: Select the physical phase the load is connected to: L1, L2 or L3. Select Three-phase only for a real three-phase load.
data_description.expected_runtime_minutes: Enter the typical number of minutes the device runs after starting. This estimates how many kWh must be reserved from the flexible-energy budget.
data_description.min_battery_soc: Below this battery percentage Casa ES will not consider the device admissible. This is a per-device battery protection threshold.
data_description.allow_grid: Off: the device is admissible only when current PV power can cover it. On: it may also use grid energy, while still respecting electrical limits and the energy budget.
data_description.enabled: Turn this off to keep the device configured but exclude it from Casa ES decisions without deleting it.
